existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: R6 `Medication` preserves identity but has multiple hard local instance breaks. The top concerns are local element renames/removals, ingredient choice/type rewrites, and R6-only package/product-definition data that cannot round-trip to R4. Confidence is high for structural findings; terminology and rationale confidence would improve with official diffs and expansions.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should be treated as a field-level transform, not a version-label update. Rename or restructure top-level fields (`form`, `manufacturer`, `amount`, `batch`), rewrite ingredient representation (`item[x]` to `CodeableReference`, `strength` to `strength[x]`), and define explicit downgrade extensions for R6-only `role`, `definition`, `packageSize`, `instance.identifier`, `SubstanceDefinition`, and non-Ratio strengths.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for local structural changes because both assigned StructureDefinitions were present and directly compared. Confidence is medium for semantic rationale and terminology impact because no official diff/change note or terminology-server expansion was used, and the R6 input is a ballot build.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Medication keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 6 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 3 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 1 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 3, which creates meaningful stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 70/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

7 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Medication.batch was renamed to instance and gained instance.identifier
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `batch` is unknown in R6; R6 `instance.identifier` also has no base R4 location for reverse conversion.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Medication.form was renamed to doseForm
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: `form` is not a base R6 Medication element; R6 `doseForm` is also not a base R4 Medication element.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Medication.manufacturer was replaced by marketingAuthorizationHolder with narrower semantics
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances carrying `manufacturer` have an element unknown to base R6, and generated models/business rules also move from a manufacturer property to a MAH property.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Medication.amount was replaced by packageSize.numberOfItems and packageSize.amountPerItem
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `amount` is unknown in R6 and must be restructured; R6 `packageSize` values, especially count plus amount-per-item, do not collapse cleanly to the single R4 Ratio.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Ingredient item changed from item[x] choice to CodeableReference and added SubstanceDefinition target
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 choice-suffixed names are not R6 element names; reverse conversion can also lose `SubstanceDefinition` references or a CodeableReference that carries both concept and reference.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Ingredient strength changed from Ratio to strength[x] with Ratio, CodeableConcept, or Quantity
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 `strength` is not the R6 choice-suffixed name; R6 `strengthCodeableConcept` and `strengthQuantity` have no base R4 equivalent.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Medication.status keeps the same required codes but changes code definitions toward record currency
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: semantic/documentation: the same instances validate, but runtime rules or enum documentation that attach behavior to `active`/`inactive` may interpret the codes differently.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Medication.ingredient.role was added and is not representable in base R4 Medication
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: a populated R6 role is not a base R4 element, but there is no old-valid/new-invalid R4-to-R6 break.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: populated R6 `definition` references and their target resources cannot be represented in base R4, but R4-to-R6 instances are unaffected.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
